Move floor to floor across a grid-based map, managing scarce ammo and resources while deciding when to push deeper for a richer haul and when to extract back to camp. Between runs, process what you carried out into permanent upgrades to your loadout and your camp, then go further.

title: Solomon Program
description: Solomon Program is a turn-based strategy game in which players fight one-on-one on a chess or shogi-like board field. Players are free to construct their own action patterns for each unit using pre-defined elements ("phrases"). Up to four units can be added to the deck, from which a "king" is designated. The player who defeats the opponent's "King" wins.

title: F1 Team Simulation: Project F
description:
Project F is a managerial simulation that puts the player in the role of the owner of a Formula 1 company. The player is responsible for paying salary to managers, mechanics, and other members of the staff; it is possible to raise or lower the salary, which may lead to various consequences depending on the employee's personality. Then the player makes contract with one or more drivers, selecting them from a list. Car customization plays an important role. Gasoline, engines, chassis, wheels, tires, brakes, and other components must be purchased from manufacturers of the player's choice. 
 
The racing competition itself is non-interactive. Tournament events follow depending on its schedule, and the player simply watches how the race unfolds and ends according to the participants' parameters. Brand and player names in the game resemble real ones, but have been slightly altered for copyright reasons.

title: Hawk F-123
description: Horizontal shoot 'em up similar in style to Power Gate, although technically more advanced.

title: Gibo: Sayaka
description:
Sayaka Kimura is a twenty-six year old women married to an older man who has two teenage children, a boy and a girl. Controlling different members of this household, the player follows a plot that mostly consists of sexual encounters of various kinds. 
 
Gibo: Sayaka plays mostly like a visual novel, with sparse movement and interaction, usually comprising context-specific action and dialogue choices. Most of the game is dedicated to sex scenes during which the player has to repeatedly go through the choices to trigger new ones and eventually conclude the scene.

title: Camisole
description: Heroine Tenjin Shima is a manager of the lingerie shop, but on the behind this is a private investigation organization. One day a request is received from the National University to find the professor missing for a week already. All that's known is that professor was interested in excavation of an ancient civilization and searched for a hidden treasure.

title: Humble Rumble
description: Humble Rumble is a multiplayer physics-based brawling party game spanning several maps, themes and modes. Compete or co-operate with your friends across various activities from battles at sea to farming to gift giving.

title: Olaguna Chronicles
description: In Olaguna Chronicles Every character in the game will have a profile, and some will change their lives because of the decisions you make! Their records will be different! Maybe it's a friend, maybe it's an enemy...

title: Deepsea Salvor
description: This highly randomized action rogue-like is all about strategic positioning and using power-ups to their fullest extent. Look for frequent updates to this early access title.

title: Walking Simulator
description: You are Delivery Bot 1, tasked to get parcels from point A to B in the most barren and desolate places on earth.

title: Block Multiplayer: RPG
description: CyberMotion Games presents you the online role-playing game Block Multiplayer RPG, which will certainly fascinate all the players! The new project will combine a favorite and familiar RPG gameplay with notes of unique innovations.

title: Touhou Soccer Moushuuden
description: Touhou Soccer Moushuuden is a Touhou Project fangame that's a stand-alone expansion to Touhou Soccer that adds various new features to the original game. It includes the original game's Main Scenario mode, and adds sub-scenarios for a number of characters in which you can unlock new moves. It also features Campaign Mode, a 25-game mode focused on building your own team by buying players and items; and All-Star Mode, where you can play exhibition matches against the AI or other players.

title: Touhou Pocket Wars
description: Touhou Pocket Wars is fan-made Touhou Project strategic RPG based around Gacha Figurines. The player plays themselves as a Touhou-character themed Gacha collector, entering tournaments and leveling up their figurines and accompanying spell cards to take on stronger and stronger opponents.

title: Touhou Pocket Wars Evolution
description: Touhou Pocket Wars Evolution is a fan-made Touhou Project strategic RPG based around Gacha Figurines. Released as a sequel to Touhou Pocket Wars, the player assumes the role of a Touhou-character themed Gacha collector, entering tournaments and leveling up their figurines and accompanying spell cards to take on stronger and stronger opponents.

title: Touhou Pocket Wars Evolution Plus
description: Touhou Pocket Wars Evolution Plus is an expansion that was released at Fancy Frontier16 in July, 2010. It adds a follow-up story and new characters, as well as characters of Undefined Fantastic Object in battle.

title: Little Gardens
description: Explore a world of tiny gardens, shady parks and secret glades. Solve puzzles and build gardens as you explore your way through 30+ levels!

title: Infinity Wars 2
description: A Simultaneous turn-based strategy card game, honoring the original Infinity Wars, with refurbished systems and a stronger codebase, for the best possible Infinity Wars Experience.

title: Six Sided Sanctuary
description: Six Sided Sanctuary is a puzzle game where you attach panels with special properties to the sides of a cube. Depending on the orientation of the panels they can help you reach your goal. Fly, flop, and find your way through 25+ unique levels in three unique themes

title: Sierra Ops
description: Woefully ill-prepared, play as Junius as he struggles to uncover long-lost secrets new and old while fighting an impossible war.

title: Sierra Ops: Episode 2 - Dissonance and Resonance
description:
With the front lines inching ever closer to Earth after the devastating battle at Mondshire, Junius must come to terms with his new role, and with those who he must now fight beside as mixed opinions about his promotions arise. Given the freedom to choose his assignments, the newly minted Captain and Squadron Leader is faced with the dilemma of having too little time to accomplish too much in a post befitting of someone far more experienced. As one of the few elites chosen for the reborn, 1st fleet of old, Junius must fight to meet the expectation of those all around him and earn the respect of his crew while struggling to do his duty and what he believes is right.
Will he able to rally his crew to action?
Will the United Terran Vanguard be able to put itself back together before it’s too late?
Is it possible to wage a just war?

Sierra Ops Episode 2: Dissonance and Resonance is part two of a four-part series where both decisions made and performance in combat change the power balance of the two armed forces.
Is it even possible to end this war without losing everything?

title: Sierra Ops: Episode 3 - Unending Dusk
description: Sierra Ops Episode 3: Unending Dusk is part three of a four-part series where both decisions made and performance in combat change the power balance of the two armed forces. Is it even possible to end this war without losing everything?

title: Sierra Ops: Episode 4 - Cadence of the Morning Star
description:
Sierra Ops Episode 4: Cadence of the Morning Star is the final part of a four-part series where both decisions made and performance in combat change the power balance of the two armed forces.
Is it even possible to end this war without losing everything?

With the released of episode 4, “New Game +” mode will be unlocked and playable with any save that has reached any one of the normal endings of the game.
...Will this time be different? One can only wonder.

title: Spaß Taxi
description: Spaß Taxi is a clone of the original Space Taxi, where you need to bring passengers from one pad to another in weird environments with unexpected obstacles.

title: Tasty Shafts
description:
"Will you go out with me?"
Mitsuna was asked to go out by the twins, Kyouichi and Reiji, at the same time!

It was too difficult of a choice for indecisive Mitsuna to make. "I can't choose between Kyouichi and Reiji......"

"Well, then will you go out with both of us?"
The trio then started a new life which they enjoy doing everything together including sex!

title: Amakano: Second Season
description:
This is the fandisc for Amakano ~Second Season~, with two episodes for each of the four heroines: a summer episode and a future episode culminating in marriage. Plus 4 append scenarios (per heroine) on top of all that.

It also includes other bonuses like minigames, unlockable voicelines, wallpapers, and a sprite viewer.

title: Super Barista
description:
Serve coffee in the outer space to a cast of crazy caffeine addicted aliens.

Strategy action game that mixes tower defense and time management.

title: Tentacles Growing Everywhere
description:
Puberty is weird and awkward, especially when you happen to be a tentacled space alien! 
 
In this incredibly queer mashup of Judy Blume, Babysitters Club, and pulpy sci-fi, join three childhood friends -- Charlie, Jace, and Valentine -- as they write to each other in their online journals about going to new schools, fitting in, crushing on cuties, dealing with adults who just don't understand, and of course, all those bizarre new changes taking place in their bodies.

title: The Tawashi
description: It's a vertical scrolling shooting game (Vertical Shmup) with a slightly nostalgic atmosphere! Avoid and shoot and avoid and shoot and avoid!

title: Strange Passion - My Boss, My Mistress
description: Bondage Office Dating Visual Novel

title: Why Is There A Girl In My House?!
description: What would you do if you found a cat girl in your apartment? Elena is a hard working businesswoman who just can't find time for herself - until one day she meets Alice, an excitable cat girl, under less than optimal circumstances. What happens next? Find out in this short yuri visual novel!

title: Bishoujo Mangekyou: Kotowari to Meikyuu no Shoujo
description: Last game in the Bishoujo Mangekyou series.

title: Dogforce
description: It's time for walkies! You've been let off your leash for 45 seconds in the park, so it's time to cram in all the dog business you can before it's time to go home. Use your super DOGFORCE powers to score as many points as you can - scare off birds, show the world how much you love it, and catch every ball and frisbee you can.

title: Royals
description:
An old forgotten game from your youth.
You can't find the manual.

title: Lil Ghost Garden
description: Take care of the garden. The window plays even if you do something else - just keep it in a corner. Features plant mutations, emoticon-based communication and chillness.

title: Maquisard
description: Maquisard is a charming game of snooping and investigation. As the lobby boy at a fancy hotel, the player receives clues from the resistance about the identity of a government agent and tries to figure out their identity by snooping on the guests over the course of three days. Players must listen in on conversations, peek into rooms, and observe the guests' habits in order to figure out which guests has all the traits of their target. Maquisard is a single-player puzzle game that has an unique non-linear investigation gameplay and draws on the visual aesthetics of Wes Anderson's film The Grand Budapest Hotel.

title: Substratum
description: Marooned on a uncharted planet, you decide to explore. There's something strange about the rocks here - better be careful where you point that laser gun of yours.

title: Venari
description: Embark on an epic adventure to an ancient, mysterious island where your escape room puzzle skills will be put to the test. In Venari, uncover the secrets hidden on the island and discover the legendary Venari artefact.

title: Help Me, I'm Drowning
description: A strange and goofy adventure set in a world where the water is orange and the dirt is pink. Our hero Leftie meets some new friends and has a great time.

title: Desert of Doitjma
description: Follow Murphy on this evil adventure. Survive all the sectors and collect the keys from this alternate reality to fight Doitjma itself for Earth's freedom!

title: Playmobil: The Movie VR Adventures
description: Become a character of the Playmobil movie. Join your buddy Del on a crazy journey across super fun worlds. Make weird burritos for hungry cowboys, beat funky space aliens at a dancing contest, and infiltrate a secret base guarded by sneaky agents. This is VR family fun to the next level.

title: Fever Cabin
description: Survive five challenging and anxiety inducing nights by making sure zombies and other creatures stay out of the cabin.

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor
description: Join over 13 million players in the award-winning online multiplayer RPG. Explore the frozen tundra and snowy mountains of Western Skyrim and stop a powerful Vampire Lord from enslaving Tamriel in The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor, part of the year-long gothic adventure The Dark Heart of Skyrim.

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Harrowstorm
description: Set upon a journey that will take you into Skyrim's darkest reaches with Harrowstorm, a new dungeon DLC game pack. Investigate a supernatural storm in Icereach and delve into the accursed depths of Unhallowed Grave as you discover the dark forces that threaten Skryim in this first installment of a year-long saga.

title: Childhood
description:
Childhood is a third-person narrative adventure that uses survival, resource management and stealth as main mechanics to tell Kayra's story, a 13-year-old orphan who needs to take care of her two siblings, Nia and Yeru, and carry on in a hostile setting inspired by the large cities around Southeast Asia.

- Gather enough resources and money to survive

- Look for food, water and meds on the streets

- Beg for money to buy anything you need

- Steal stores without being noticed

- Get back home and share everything

- Tell fairytales to your little sister

title: Bicycle Board Games
description: This game features 16 board games, including classics like Chess, Checkers, and Dominoes, as well as new games like Five Dice and Color Match.

title: Turtle VR
description: Turtle VR brings the Logo turtle into the 21st century. Use an interface similar to MIT Scratch, and Google Blockly, to program a turtle to draw your creations within various 3D worlds.

title: Madball
description: A game of controlling a constantly rolling ball through a series of unpredictable and exciting obstacles.

title: FireTry
description: Firetry is a beautiful and fun game. There are more than 50 episodes in the game. You can design a section yourself or modify an existing section design. It also has a feature that makes this game different from other games. In this game you can manage the characters with your own code.

title: L'Cestrue Seyuntres
description: In L'Cestrue Seyuntres, follow the story of Leonard and his fellow companions as they fight to save the world of Festiya from succumbing to darkness!

title: Former Future
description: Former Future is a strategic top-down 2D shooter where you face an invading alien threat on the frontier world of Saturn and its neighboring moons.

title: Box Kid Adventures
description: Box Kid Adventures is a dynamic, top-down puzzle game. You play as Box Kid – a toy made of cardboard – going through various levels, full of nasty enemies and brain challenging puzzles.

title: Die Legende von Saya - Befehl aus der Dunkelheit
Paws & Effect: My Dogs Are Human!
description: A quirky, comedic visual novel where dogs transform into people and nonsense ensues! Your choices will teach them about the human condition, but beware: They're not the only ones listening. Mysteries and irreverence await you in Paws & Effect: My Dogs Are Human!

title: Mindless
description: "Mindless" is a suspenseful FMV (Full Motion Video) interactive movie game. In this game, the player plays a detective with amnesia and uses the mindless system to experience the entire process of the case. By observing the behavior of everyone on the scene and the objects left on the scene after the incident, the player can find the key to solve the mystery and unlock more Multiple dialogue scenes and mysterious clues.

title: Born Punk
description: A former combat hacker, a corporate CEO and a gangsta-rapping android get possessed by mysterious, otherworldly entities and must band together to save themselves and uncover the entities' origins. Talk, puzzle and explore your way through this (often humorous) cyberpunk thriller.

title: Offroad Mania
description: Offroad Mania — based on realistic car physics game for everyone, who like off road and challenge. We've prepared for you 120 levels (rocks, trees, bridges, ramps etc.), 5 amazing 4×4 off road cars (differents suspensions, engines) for fun driving.

title: Being a DIK
description: Being a DIK is a choice driven adult Visual Novel focusing on the fun parts of college life. The game is packed with humor, sex, romance, drama and a rich story. Play as a young male attending college at B&R and guide him through the experience.

title: Apple Slash
description: Repel an invasion of mysterious charming creatures in a vast murky marshland. Strike your foes in a God-like slash-based manner and experience ambiguous encounters brimming with personality.

title: Soul Reaper
description: Reap souls by besting your foes in turn-based combat, then summon them to fight by your side! Arrange souls on a 3x3 grid for battle, or attach them to loot pieces to amplify their effects! Travel through The Vault in search for rare treasure, and slay the impostors claiming to be the Soul Reaper!

title: Monster Energy Supercross: The Official Videogame 3
description: New ground and in-air physics, new rider models and new animations will create a more immersive experience and enable you to enjoy the Supercross world at its best!

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Dark Brotherhood
description: Though at the height of their power, the Dark Brotherhood faces a grave threat in the form of a mysterious black-armored warrior capable of bringing down their best agents. Venture forth for another exciting adventure in the Elder Scrolls Online as you carve a bloody swath across Tamriel in the name of the Dark Brotherhood!

title: Folklore Hunter
description: You are a hunter world reknowned for slaying supernatural beasts. Your next contract is to hunt down a wendigo plaguing a section of woods in north america. Gather resources, set traps, prepare your equipment, use your hunters instincts and take down the beast, before it hunts you.

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Shadows of the Hist
description: The Elder Scrolls Online: Shadows of the Hist is the fifth DLC for The Elder Scrolls Online. It contains the two Argonian-themed dungeons of the Cradle of Shadows and Ruins of Mazzatun.

title: Jewel Match IV
description: Jewel Match IV is a match-three game with thew occasional hidden object levels and puzzles. To make matches, swap two tiles to create a row of three or more of the same tile in a horizontal or vertical line. To clear most levels, you must make matches over gold tiles to remove them. Later, you will encounter unpolished tiles that must be matched twice to clear them. Each level has more than one board and most board are wider than the screen, requiring you to scroll to see everything. As you progress, items will hinder you like chains, fog and boxes. You will have assistance from other wizards with things like breaking groups of chains or temporarily clearing fog so you can see what gems are there. After a couple levels, when you match four items together, you create a rainbow gem that can be matched with any two gems that are the same color. When you match five gems, you create a helix that can clear an entire horizontal row.

title: Weed Farmer Simulator
description: Become a weed farmer! You just moved out of the city and bought land for growing some weed. It might not look like much right now but only your imagination is the limit!

title: Togainu no Chi: Lost Blood
description:
Akira's life has been defined by violence, but that won't be enough to save him when he's forced to play a deadly game. Will the bonds you forge in this stunning visual novel lead to his salvation, or to his ruin?

This is a remastered version of Togainu no Chi from 2005, featuring higher resolution assets and improved compatibility.

title: Blood of Steel
description: BOS is an Online Multiplayer PvP MOBA game featuring iconic heroes from world history. As a warlord, you can lead various legions and heroes, commanding them to slay your enemies in bloody battlefields. Let’s take to the rankings, seize territories or partake in strategic battles.

title: Kingpin: Reloaded
description:
Kingpin: Reloaded is an enhanced re-release of the 1999 first-person shooter Kingpin: Life of Crime.

The enhanced version features 4K resolution, ultrawide support, and improved graphics, more accessible controls, and new quest and conversation systems.

title: Senren Banka
description:
The village of Hoori lies deep in the middle of the mountains, inaccessible by rail. Since there isn’t much interaction with its surroundings, the town seems like it is stuck in the past. However, it is because of this exact olden feel and subsequent development that it has turned into a nice hot-springs town for tourists.

One of the popular sightseeing spots is the legendary katana Murasamemaru, embedded in stone. No one has been able to pull it out… until Masaomi somehow broke it in half. He has to take responsibility for his actions: “Marriage” with ‘shrine maiden princess’ Yoshino!? He was perplexed at the unexpected turn of events, but this is only just the beginning. What lies ahead for him is a much more peculiar and mysterious life, including his new fiancée, a mysterious girl who only he could touch, and the secret behind the curse that remains on the town.

What will become of Masaomi’s love amidst his rapidly changing life? The answer lies within the Murasamemaru in his hands.

title: Santa's Workshop: Unhinged
description: Help! Santa's Toy Machine Broke! Quick, find places to get rid of all the presents before it's too late and the room fills up with too many of them!!!

title: Journey to the East
description: Explore a world inspired by philosophies, religions and folklore of the Far East in this 2D action-RPG.

title: Equestria
description:
the goal is to finish the song in low time

hitting the moon with pegasus lowers time

gettin hit in neck by eyeball increases time

title: Tuboflex
description: Year 2010. The need for flexible labor has grown exponentially since the beginning of the century. Today, the protections and bureaucracy of traditional staffing solutions aren't sustainable anymore: a single worker may be needed by different companies over the course of the same day. That's why Tuboflex inc., the world's leading Human Resources Services company, created a complex system of tubes that allow us to allocate employees in real time according to the market's demand. Playing the role of a Tuboflex employee, you have to survive this ultra-dynamic labour market, getting quickly used to the most disparate tasks. Welcome to the Tube Age.

title: Scribbly Walrus
description:
Enjoy the fun of being a walrus! 
 
* Use your tusk and whiskers to find hidden shellfish 
 
* Swim with a beluga 
 
* Rest on an ice floe 
 
Did you know walruses are in trouble? Man made climate change has led to a huge decrease in arctic sea ice. Walruses don't have a lot of stamina, and need to rest on those ice floes in between foraging. Without ice to rest on, they have no choice but to flee inland, resulting in 35,000 walruses rushing the coast of Alaska all at once. 
 
Walruses aren't the only marine mammal in trouble. As of this moment there are only 97 vaquita porpoises left in the world. Vaquita are the world's smallest porpoise, and their numbers are plunging due to unregulated gill-net fishing and demand for the shrimp and fish that share their habitat.

title: Kiwi 64
description:
Kiwi 64 is a small hommage to that one 3D collect-a-thon platformer by that one UK gamedeveloper.

It features one world and challenges you to collect five magical lamps in order to get the evil melon down from the mountain in the middle.

The music is part of Jay Moser's amazing album "Bear and Bird".

title: Responding
description:
Responding is a First/Third Person Shooter with emphasis on the daily routine and work of the NYPD, NYSP, EMS and Fire Services in the State of New York. 
While the focus is still heavily emphasized on the city of New York itself, we aim to create a lush and varied outback. Responding, will feature a massive landmass to explore, ranging from islands, forests, hilly and mountainous areas and lush beautiful beaches. 
The game will even let you explore the city of New York.

title: Action Painting Pro
description: Discover your inner Pollock.

title: Corgi Simulator
description: This is a full motion video game created for the Space Cowboy Game Jam. You play as Ein, a data dog who's been kidnapped by two smugglers. Your goal is to manipulate these humans into leaving their computers unattended so you can hack your way back to the Bebop.

title: 3 Missing, 4am
description: You are alone in a dark place.

title: The Clotted Island
description: It's and indie, puzzle and abstract game.

title: Party Business
description: You are a cake, and must collect presents for a party. Your boss at PartyCo tells you that parties are serious business. Forks try to eat you, because you are a cake.

title: Battle Cube
description: Battle Cube - is a 2D platformer with surviving elements and unusual bonus system. Having them, a player gets unique abilities to prevent all obstacles on the way.

title: Jojo's Bizarre Adventure: The 7th Stand User
SpaceWrestler XL
description:
'Mad Meteor' Mike became the more powerful wrestler on Earth, and after winning WrestleDeath XL 1986, he ascended and transformed into a cosmic titan of wrestling power. Too big for Earth and hungry for foes to challenge him, Mike travelled through space, slamming planets to fuel his powers while ancient Wrestle-Lords try to take him down. 
 
Dodge and outmanoeuvre rivals while building up power, then slam them out of the galaxy when the time is right. Grab folding chairs, TVs and other weapons to put the odds in your favour! 
 
'Generate-a-Wrestler' feature gives the powerful Wrestle-Lords unique names and appearances as you fight through space, who knows who you'll be drop-kicking next?

title: Electric Tortoise
description: Blade Runner and I, Robot-inspired interrogation game.

title: Morning Coffee
description: A short-form narrative game about the morning routine, and a bit more…

title: Rain
description:
Rain is a short surrealist, experiemental game. This was a week long project that started from the 3 hour game jam with the theme: Rain.

It's an experiment in trying out a different art style that would suit my skills.

It's also a personal game, where I tried to figure out my own personality and translate that into different aspects of the game. Something like a journal, in interactive form. Enjoy the experience.

title: Trembling Dots
description: ... was originally a 2009 TIGSource Assemblee entry, constrained to use exclusively the art and sound assets produced in the first half of the competition. This is an updated Unity remake of the original Multimedia Fusion 2 version.

title: The Entertainment
description:
'The Entertainment' was first presented at the Buffalo Street Student Theatre on the evening of November 16th, 1973, with the following cast:

HARRY ESPERANZA ............. Edgar Foy
LAWRENCE SLADE .............. Allen Vogel
PEARL SLADE ................. Sarah Wakefield
ROSA SLADE .................. Sydney Mueller
EVELYN HICKMAN .............. Paula Graves
BAR-FLY ..................... Uncredited

The production was directed by James B. Carrington. The setting was designed by Lula Chamberlain. The plays 'A Reckoning' and 'A Bar-fly' were written by Lem Doolittle, and later adapted by Joseph Wheattree for simultaneous performance as 'The Entertainment.'

title: Bite Me
description: Bite Me is an RPG. It is playable alone or online; it is composed of a Twitch integration. Improve your skills as well as your weapons and enter the legend by fighting, monsters, spectators, broadcasters, or other players!

title: Atum
description: Atum is a mod for Minecraft developed by Shadowclaimer that adds a new desert dimension containing over ten new mobs, over twenty-five unique artifacts to find and use, dungeons, ruins, and temples.

title: Fignermukcre
description: Trollcore Enterpries TM is proud to present Fignermukcre, a Delightfully Frustrating TM experience for two to six fingers.

title: Ollam House
description: bounce bounce

title: Kyoto
description:
Spiral into audioreactive obscurity as you are transported to a mysterious and melancholy land. Kyoto is an interactive ambient musical experiment that serves is an homage to the wonderful city that I currently reside in. 
 
This short and sweet game serves as half audioreactive experiment and half tech sandbox.

title: Find Me A Good One
description: Find Me A Good One is a surreal puzzle platformer in which you are tasked to find, chat with, and navigate dream characters back to your brother in order to fend off the nightmares sneaking into his bedroom.

title: Panic Crisis Mage Attack
description:
Panic Crisis Mage Attack is a horizontal shooter in which you play as a mage and shoot things with magic on a magical adventure at a magical castle. 
 
Features: 
 
* Main scenario with 5 stages and 6 bosses 
* Epilogue scenario for players with high endurance 
* Vengeance scenario for masochistic players 
* Four difficulty settings, from Casual to Master 
* Two playable characters

title: MemGame
description: MemGame is a freeware, two player, mouse controlled, concentration game. It can be played player vs player or player vs computer.

title: Red Horizon
description: Red Horizon is an addictive space shmup game. Heavily influenced by the classics of the past, Red Horizon takes a modern spin on the genre combining it with some subtle Rogue-like elements to provide players with a unique experience every time they play.

title: Half-Life 2 Classic
description: Half-Life 2 Classic is a Half-Life 1 mod that aims to recreate the entirety of Half-Life 2.

title: Number Munchers
description: Learn basic math skills with Number Munchers. Keep your Muncher away from the Troggles by munching on multiples, factors, prime numbers, equalities, and inequalities. If you can stay away from the Troggles and earn enough points, you'll be part of the Muncher Hall of Fame.

title: Lakeview Cabin
description: Murder RPG set in the shady town of Lakeview Valley. See how you'll do as a new home owner in the Valley, where everyone seems to have a secret. Become the toast of the town or succumb to your dark desires. The choice is yours. But however you choose to play, beware... There is something evil lurking beneath the surface...

title: Tape Dream
description:
The Game Which Has Captivated A Million Lost Spirits!

Collect tapes! Feed excess tapes and ritual objects into the slots of the "Alchemy Machine"! Combine tapes for great profit, fun... See what mysteries are unlocked in the world of "Tape Dream: The Game Your Ethereal Relatives Wish They Could Play"!

title: To Build a Better Mousetrap
description: A semi-abstract management game.

title: False Rebirth
description: A psychological, story-focused game about the last remaining human, and his search for meaning in a post-apocalyptic world.

title: False Awakening - Episode 1
description: 'False Awakening' is a dark, story-focused, psychological game, about a young man who is stuck in his dream, and is unable to wake up from it.

title: False Awakening - Episode 2
description:
'False Awakening' is a dark, story-focused, psychological game about a young man who is stuck inside his own dream. 
 
While Episode 1 was relatively light, this Episode 2 deals with a more darker aspect of the story.

title: Vidiot Game
description:
Can you figure out what the hell is going on? Probably not, but have fun trying!
Features multiple mini-games, several plots and schemes, wacky effects and Ungus Fungus Doug Beach, and Hiratio as playable characters. Vidiot Game has gamepad support.

title: Queer Power
description: In Queerland people don't have fixed sexual attributes nor gender roles. They make love according to their ever-changing desires. Forget what you learned at school about the two genders and enjoy a trip in this odd world!

title: Striptease
description: ps. It's linear

title: Benthic Love
description:
The original, critically acclaimed Anglerfish Dating Simulator! Explore the bottom of the sea in search of a mate. But be careful, because male anglerfish need to find a mate in order to live, but by doing so they also cease to exist as anything other than a pair of testes. 
 
Features: 
- 5 endings! 
- Learn interesting facts about the ocean depths! 
- The ONLY LGBT-friendly fish dating sim!

title: SuteF
description: suteF is a puzzle platforming game where you must push boxes, grapple walls, activate switches, and avoid lasers to make your escape from the dreaded land known only as the 'Abyss.'

title: Solaris
description: "Solaris" is a story about a journey in search of yourself. The hero fulfills the last will of a loved one, meeting many strange characters. The road is full of humor, but the further you go, the stronger the feeling becomes: beneath the cozy surface, something terrible is awakening.

title: Don't Lose Your Head
description:
It's a simple little platformer.
You, uh, dodge stuff. Try not to die too much; it makes a big
mess of things.
Have fun. Tell me what you think.

title: The Idolmaster: Starlit Season
description: Now, the girls are getting started Produce the "Project Luminous," a joint unit of the four brands from the The Idolmaster series! New idols are also scouted for "Project Luminous" and unfold a completely new story!

title: The Fish Market
description: Enjoy the opportunity to explore an underwater market.

title: Bump
description: Engage in fast-paced cyberpunk multiplayer arena combat. Utilize normal/charged shots, jumps, dashes, bullet time, and wall climbing for strategic advantage to push your enemies out of the arena and win the game.

title: Unmanned
description: Now you get to play the newest kind of soldier: one who remotely drops bombs on foreign soil during the day, and at night goes home to his family in the suburbs. In Unmanned, the conflict is internal -- the only blood you'll shed is from shaving cuts. But is there collateral damage in this new way of waging war?

title: Team Fortress
description: Team Fortress (TF) is a team- and class-based multiplayer online first-person shooter video game mod based on id Software's Quake Engine, and later QuakeWorld Engine. Team Fortress, also known as Quake Team Fortress (QTF), and later QuakeWorld Team Fortress (QWTF), was designed and written by Robin "Bro" Walker, John "Jojie" Cook, and Ian "Scuba" Caughley in 1996. Because of its popularity, it has spawned an endless amount of mods for not only Team Fortress, but other games as well. Valve took an interest in the Team Fortress Software organization and hired the three creators to work on a Team Fortress Half-Life mod, and later a standalone version called Team Fortress Classic (TFC), released in 1999. A standalone sequel to Team Fortress Classic, Team Fortress 2 (TF2), was developed by Valve and released in 2007.

title: Nuclear Titbit: Flashback
description: Russian arcade game. A version of the game, which is not an adventure or a sequel, released by Russobit Publishing. The idea and scenario of the game belong to Daniil Shepovalov. In 2004 the game won the Gameland Awards in the category "Best Quest of 2004",

title: A Night in the Woods
description: A quiet game about the end of the world.

title: TV Giant
description: If you're tired of cheesy TV shows, why not start your own channel? This is what TV Giant offers you on PC. Become the king of the audience by creating your own programs, responding to public demand and carrying out your own surveys by surveying the 3D streets of the city. You will be able to know the satisfaction rate.

title: Vertebreaker
description: A new game by the creators of Sonic Mania.

title: Rebel Transmute
description: Set on a living planet, Rebel Transmute is a sprawling metroidvania with fully customizable combat and platforming. Explore a vibrant ecosystem, befriend sentient robots, and fight the colonizers standing between you and your missing mother!

title: Stocksynd House
description: Stocksynd House is a story-driven virtual reality escape the room style experience. Giving you an intense feeling of immersion and isolation, this VR game will push your psychological senses to breaking point.

title: Duel on Board
description: Duel on Board is a 1 vs 1 local multiplayer competitive / party game where pirates fight for the precious beer while sailing the dangerous high seas. Just like old school games, you can play with your friend on the same keyboard!

title: Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions
description:
A new Captain Tsubasa game is here, 10 years after the release of the previous console game!

The worlds of Soccer and Anime converge in Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions, based on the renowned Captain Tsubasa series. The game chronicles the athletic exploits of Tsubasa Ozora as he plays out his love for the game and advances through the ranks of multiple Soccer leagues. Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions immerses players in an action packed soccer game that features exhilarating gameplay, over the top signature shots and accessible gameplay.

title: Screaming Chicken: Ultimate Showdown
description: Screaming Chicken: Ultimate Showdown is a wacky multiplayer party game with physics-based slapstick, completely destructible environments, and tons of crazy weapons. Roast other chickens and become the last chicken standing!

title: Withstand: Survival
description: Play as journalist who arrived to unknown island to reveal all the mysteries and find information about secret government experiments. Explore beautiful and dangerous open world. Try to survive, fight enemies, craft new objects and complete quests to reveal what happened.

title: Disruption
description: Disruption is a third-person fight for the future of humanity set in the near future, quasi-dystopian world where robots, driven by the global corporate imperative for cheap and obedient labor, are displacing humans at all levels of the workforce.

title: Mobile Suit Gundam: Extreme vs. Maxiboost - On
description:
Mobile Suit Gundam Extreme Vs. Maxi Boost ON is a port of the arcade version of the same game, that started operation in 2016.
This 2vs2 team battle action game allows you to control Mobile Suits that have appeared in numerous Gundam works! In addition to the 183 units that appeared in the arcade version, you can also use 2 MS that are new to the game !

title: Putt-Putt Saves the Stew
description:
So this is an adventure game designed entirely by my 4.5 year old son Eric. 
 
He was playing a lot of Putt-Putt Saves The Zoo at the time. He started joking about Putt-Putt having to save other rhyming things (we do a lot of dumb punning), and we started talking about what Putt-Putt Saves The Stew would be like, and pretty soon we had agreed to set aside a big chunk of a Saturday actually making it.

title: Haunted Cities
description: A collection of three short, experimental games originally released via Kitty Horrorshow's Patreon.

title: Glider Classic
description:
The Macintosh classic re-imagined. 
 
Fly your paper airplane through a house relying on lift from air vents in the floor. Duck under obstacles, avoid electrical outlets and all the other hazards that await your fragile glider. 
 
Have fun exploring the house!

title: Evenicle 2
description:
There is an illness spreading through the world called the ‘hero disease’ where using magic will result in early death. People skilled in combat fought with monsters aware of their shortening lifespan. They fought to eliminate as many monsters as possible to protect their families and friends.

In this tragic world appeared a young man, Alex, who was blessed with a legendary healing ability. His body fluids can cure any ailment without physical trauma. He set out to save the girls suffering from the ‘hero disease’.

title: Taur
description: Taur is an action-strategy sci-fi game. Control the Prime Cannon and unlock all of its powerful weapons and abilities. Build turrets, droids, aircraft and more as you fight to protect the Tauron droids' homeworld against a relentless invasion. Will your Taur stand against the Imperion warmachine?

title: Panty Raider - From Here to Immaturity
GOR - Gorilla Office Rampage!
description:
in this video game you play as a monkey and you smash stuff. 
 
you gotta collect 8 special items in order to defeat the dangerous duck creature monster. You pick up bananas and go insane rampage mode and move very fast with immense speed and good stuff and yeah that's game!! 
 
Game was made in 4 days for a gamejam called "NM in Gameplay" here in Oslo, Norway and we had so much fun with it! We hope you will to, happy gaming! 
 
Btw, gamejam theme was "Arcade" which is why it looks like this which is quite the epic look I must dare to say

Feed yourself with chips.

Super Qube Hopper is a single player, shareware, Q*bert style game in which the player has to bounce Qubey around the screen changing all the blocks to a target colour. Naturally there are baddies trying to stop Qubey in his quest and contact with these will cost a life, the player has two lives in the shareware version of the game but in the registered version they have four lives and gain another life for every five thousand points scored.

The game is mouse or joystick controlled, has sound and voice effects and a high score table. It occupies a fixed sized window on-screen within which the game plays. The game also comes with a level construction set.

Max and Marie Go Shopping is an educational adventure game where the player must help two young anthropomorphic dogs, Max and Marie, buy all the necessary things for Aunt Lisa's party.

In this game you play as the amazing FISHBANE, a hero who fearlessly dons a diving suit in pursuit of things such as amazing Golden Harpoons and Fish.

If I may give you one little warning: the game isn't easy! It will challenge you right from the very first levels and won't relent.

Okay, that's it. Good luck to you! I really hope you enjoy the game. Now go: be Fishbane! Impale your foes; leap fearlessly across chasms; snatch harpoons; RIDE THEM THROUGH THE AIR ITSELF; and finally, be awesome!

The game includes single-player and multiplayer modes which can be played both locally and online.

Compete for the number 1 spot on the ladder or play with crazy decks against your friends without having to worry about the costs of cards. Coming 2020.

Gameplay involves stocking shelves, managing a cash register, processing online orders, and designing the store layout. Players set prices based on fluctuating market conditions. description: Faced with a dream that alters something within, you are forced to return to your abandoned childhood home. There you find a way to an unknown realm.

title: Rosewater
description:
A thrilling wild west adventure set in the world of Lamplight City! Harley Leger and her ragtag posse embark on a harrowing journey across Western Vespuccia, facing bandits, rebels, ruthless oil barons, and many more obstacles on their quest for fame and riches.

Features
- A thrilling treasure hunt with 5 travel companions. How you treat and interact with them affects the story.
- Traditional adventure game puzzles (i.e. inventory-based) some with more than one solution.
- Fully rotoscoped animations, including cinematic closeups.
- High resolution 1280x720 graphics (yes, that's 720p!)

title: Theology
description:
Theology is a management game, in which you create your very own religion and use all means necessary to spread it through the whole wide world!

Unite the World under one God, one Religion! Create your dogmas and use them to convert as many as you can to your belief system. Watch as your enemies fall and disappear, forgotten by history. From ancient times, through middle ages, to the year 2020, do everything in your power to remain dominant and in control!

Choose the location of your religion's origin. Find your first followers and use them to spread the word of your God to neighboring cities and countries. Stay in power using your own places of worship and a holy army. Convert everyone you can to your cause, peacefully or by force. The choice is yours!

KEY FEATURES:
- Create your very own religion and define all its rules and dogmas
- Build and manage places of worship
- Create armies of devoted followers
- Wage holy wars on land, sea, and in the sky
- Watch as your religion grows from ancient times to the year 2020

Start on ground level and go underground.
Your goal is to reach the target within the given time.
Every day you receive a new weapon and a new mission.
Destroy rocks & bugs, get as deep as possible and receive advice from a penguin.

title: Dark Prospect
description:
Dark Prospect is a FPS/RTS Hybrid, a genre mix, featuring 4v1 battles between upto 4 FPS player and 1 RTS player. 
 
The idea for Dark Prospect came to us because there have been more and more 4 player coop games lately. While the graphic and playful implementation is often very good, there is often a lack of really good AI that works tactically and creates interesting situations. That's why we wanted this role to be taken by a player who can observe the situation from an RTS perspective and thus has the opportunity to act more tactically than an AI could. 
 
Although Dark Prospect offers the possibility that the monsters can be controlled by an AI, the clear focus is on PVP.

title: The Sims 4: Tiny Living Stuff
description: Think big, build small with The Sims 4: Tiny Living Stuff. Create the tiny, comfy home of your Sims' dreams using space-saving furniture and a new residential lot type for small builds. Cosy up by dressing your Sims in stylish attire and oversized cashmere sweaters.

title: Rance 5D: The Lonely Girl + Rance VI: Collapse of Zeth
description: Rance 5D: The Lonely Girl + Rance VI: Collapse of Zeth is a bundle that exclusively includes both games for English audiences.

title: Code Vein: Hellfire Knight
description: New powerful foes await in the first CODE VEIN DLC, Hellfire Knight. In addition to new weapons, Blood Veils, and blood codes being added, alternate costumes for your partners are now obtainable from newly added areas in the Depths.

title: Bienvenue à la cosy académie
description:
The Cosy Academy, the most praised school in the 77!

You finally got in, it's the most beautiful day of your life, frankly.
Yeah sure, the other students are a bit weird, but there's Medoc and Moguri, your long time idols.

You might have more luck of meeting them and live adventures with them! And possibly more?

title: Thief's Roulette
description: Thief's Roulette is a Story-Driven Puzzle game inspired by the Zero Escape and Danganronpa game series. Taking the narrative heavy design of visual novels and combining it with immersive, first person puzzle gameplay, Thief's Roulette hopes to be a unique gaming experience.

title: Wasteland Remastered
description:
Originally released in 1988, Wasteland brought the post-apocalypse to video games and inspired a genre. Play one of history's defining RPGs with completely overhauled graphics, sound, and expanded musical score.

The year is 2087, nearly a century after an all-out nuclear war turned vast swaths of the Earth into a radioactive hellscape. You are a Desert Ranger, a band of stalwart lawmen who are the only hope left in what was once the American southwest, and good people's last defense against hunger, sickness, ravaging raiders, and mutants.

Now something more secretive and sinister is menacing humanity, and it's your job to investigate. Recruit help and follow leads - the choices you make will shape the world around you. Choose wisely, your life and the lives of those you're sworn to protect depend on it.

title: JumpStart Adventures 4th Grade: Haunted Island
description: JumpStart Adventures 4th Grade: Haunted Island is a JumpStart game that was made by Knowledge Adventure on December 2, 1996. It was later re-released on November 24, 1997 with Map Scroll and Ms. Grunkle's Hat level indicator added. As the title suggests, the game is intended to teach a fourth grade curriculum. It was later replaced by JumpStart Adventures 4th Grade: Sapphire Falls in 1999. In its original release, it contained KnowledgeLand as a bonus disc.

title: JumpStart Math for Second Graders
description:
JumpStart Math for Second Graders, originally known as JumpStart 2nd Grade Math, is a game released in 1997 that focuses on a second grade math curriculum.

The villainous Ratso and his gang have taken over the castle and imprisoned the royal family. CJ, the royal flycatcher, sees his chance to become a knight. He and his best friend Edison go on a quest to rescue the Royal Prisoners and dethrone Ratso.

title: JumpStart Explorers
description: JumpStart Explorers is a personal 3D computer game released by Knowledge Adventure in 2001. It focuses on history concepts for ages 5-8.

title: Tenants
description: You are a mite that has to protect its home crossing the stage to reach the plug of a vacuum cleaner which is destroying your home and is menacing to take your family. Through the way you will find some obstacles, as holes through which you can be aspirated.

title: Kindred Fates
description: Kindred Fates is an open world monster battling RPG, and a love letter to the monster battle genre. Our goal is to evolve the genre, and finally bring fans what they've been asking for.

title: Mechanica
description:
Mechanica is an open-world survival game with a heavy focus on building and programming. Create your own bases, defenses, manufacturing systems and more. Explore the map and expand the scope and complexity of your creations.

Step into a open-world, post-apocalyptic map populated by menacing robots. Establish your first base and begin automating.

Improve your defenses with a range of devices to keep the increasingly hostile robots at bay. Create farms and water pumps to keep yourself fed and hydrated. Try your best to remain alive in this hostile world.

Use the visual programming system to make objects interact in any way you wish. Make a tripwire trigger a flamethrower, use a button to instantly put your base in lockdown, control your mining outpost from across the map - anything is possible in Mechanica.

Key Features
- Build your own bases or fortify preexisting locations
- Set up advanced defenses to fend off robots
- Establish automated manufacturing systems to produce items for you
- Build farms and water pumps to keep yourself fed and hydrated

title: Mighty Math Carnival Countdown
description: The first game in the Mighty Math edutainment series.

title: Runa
description: An indie adventure inspired by JRPG classics, with turn-based battle system, social links and a story-rich science fantasy world.

title: Calculator: The Game
description:
Welcome to Calculator: The Game where you'll manipulate numbers by adding them, subtracting them, converting them, reversing them, and stuffing them through portals ... yes ... PORTALS.

Along the way you'll get to know Clicky, your adorable assistant who will hack the calculator and unlock new powerful buttons so you can destroy all the numbers ... oh wait, that's a lie, you won't be destroying any numbers ... but you WILL destroy 200 puzzles ... with NUMBERS!!

title: Evolutis: Duality
description: Be prepared to be amazed by the stunning visuals and gameplay that you will experience in Evolutis. A 2D story-driven action-adventure game inspired by 80’s animes, where the player has control over 3 protagonists that have their paths intertwined across a dramatic narrative. Every situation in the game is controlled by you and depending on your decisions, the consequences will differ.

title: Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition
description: Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition is the digital adaptation of the much-loved board game, first published in 1987 by Games Workshop. Based on the 4th Edition of the game, Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition features both online and local play, as 4 iconic vampire hunters scour Europe for Count Dracula.

title: Tower of Babel: No Mercy
description: Tower of Babel - no mercy is a multiplayer physic-based tower building game for the whole family. In this game, you and your friends build a tower together. But beware! Who makes the tower collapse loses the game.

title: Shenmue III: Battle Rally
description:
A battle race set in Bailu is about to begin!
The participants in this race are...
The hero of the story, facing off against destiny, Ryo Hazuki
The elusive, treasure-seeking Wuying Ren
and, making her first appearance in this game, Ryo's sparring partner, Wei Zhen.

title: Arcade Archives: Bells & Whistles
description: Bells & Whistles is a shooting game released by Konami in 1991. Collect bells to receive all sorts of power-ups or powerful Charged Shots and use them to save Planet Mel from being invaded by the alien Iva. During co-op play, Twinbee and Winbee can work together to use Special Power-Up attacks.

title: Arcade Archives: XX Mission
description: XX Mission is a shooting game released by UPL in 1986. While switching between air and ground attacks, take out the approaching large and small craft and large fleets. Powering up allows you to use different powerful air attacks and wider ranged ground attacks depending on the ship's form.

title: Bridge Constructor: Ultimate Edition
description:
Bridge Constructor Ultimate Edition includes the "Bridge Constructor" and both DLCs "Slopemania" and the "Trains" Expansion Pack! 
 
In Bridge Constructor, you can become an accomplished bridge builder without any formal training. Play 40 different levels, and build bridges over deep valleys, canals, or rivers. Stress tests reveal whether the bridge you build can withstand the daily stress of continual use from cars and trucks.

title: Cooking Simulator: Cakes and Cookies
description:
Bake and decorate delicious pastries, cakes, and cookies! Run your own bakery and serve customized, delightful desserts. Sweeten your favorite simulator game!

Key Features
- Brand-new bakery
- New baking mechanics
- New recipes, ingredients and utensils
- Serving customised desserts
- New Cakes and Cookies and Sandbox game modes

title: The Innsmouth Case
description: The Innsmouth Case is a choose-your-own-adventure game inspired by H.P. Lovecraft and the very first text-based adventure to combine horror and comedy in a fit and proper way.

title: Ghosts'n DJs
description: Inspired by the classic arcade hit Ghosts'n Goblins and fully created by the house music legend Dr. Kucho!, Ghosts'n DJs is a pixel-art run and gun side-scrolling action platformer set in a parallel universe in which the music scene is being dominated by fake artists and DJ’s.

title: Fourthy
description: You will have to think a lot to put everything in the right order.

title: Dig Mania
description: A game about digging holes to survive!

title: Cube Chase
description: Challenge your reflexes, navigate obstacles, dodge guards and pass checkpoints to unlock new areas and reach the glowing golden cube.

title: Racing 2020
description: Street Racing 2020 - inovation autosimulator about Street Racing and Real Tuning.

title: Car Tuner 2020
description: You love to tune your car and then test it? Then the "Car Tuner 2020" is the right choice for you. Change and improve your cars and adapt them to your wishes. Gameplay Change and improve your car. Test your car on the race track.

title: Aurora: Weather Warfare
description: An adventure game set in the near future in a world of cataclysmic climate changes. As one of the few lucky survivals, you’re about to embark on a full of peril, pitfalls, and difficult choices journey to the epicenter of the weather disaster to solve the mystery.

title: Helheim Hassle
description: Helheim Hassle is a narrative adventure game with puzzle platforming elements. Play as Bjørn, a pacifist Viking that can detach and combine limbs at will to solve challenging puzzles and get out of uncomfortable situations involving desperate Norse Gods, Goblins, Dragons, and angry skeletons.

title: House Flipper VR
description: Virtual makeovers were never more real! Thanks to the VR technology, you will be able to single-handedly take care of ruined properties, gaining your clients' appreciation and satisfaction from a job well done! Put on your goggles, take a firm grip on the controllers and become a master of renovation!

title: Interphase
description: As a rogue dreamer, you have to enter the mainframe and direct your partner to the track itself - the minds of every future generation will be trusting to your skill and intellect.

title: Devastated
description: Devastated is a post-apocalyptic action adventure game with role-playing game elements. You take control of an experimental supersoldier, and are sent to huge wasteland with only one goal: find the man responsible for the apocalypse and enslavement of the survivors, and take him down.

title: There a no Armadillos in this game
description: There a no Armadillos in this game is a puzzle platformer where you can't stop rolling and have to time your jumps precise to finish the level.

title: Naked News
description: Join in the fun with an unforgettable experience unlike any other! Naked News brings some hardcore, crass, dirty, vulgar, dark humour into an easily offended world, not pulling any punches and making fun of everything with this visual novel-style comic, Sitcom-esque episodic!

title: Secret City: Chalk of Fate - Collector's Edition
description: An otherworldly adventure in the heart of the Big Apple!

title: Xevorel: The Way Of The Feather
description: The armies of darkness are pouring in from another dimension! Explore beautifully hand-crafted locations, rediscover long-forgotten stories, and fight to save the future of civilization in Xevorel - The Way Of The Feather!

title: Zombie Towns
description: Zombie Towns is an FPS which you'll need to eliminate the zombies. In order to complete a level, you must find a key to open the gate and you will go to the next level. But look out, you can die quickly if you dont pay enough attention.

title: Boolean
description: Everything is either ON or OFF. Boolean is an open-ended problem solving game where you build circuits and send signals!

title: Kubble Star
description: Destroy all the cubes! Use the laser to launch your cubes and match your colors by 3 or more, to remove all cubes from the level to move to the next level.

title: Pioneerz
description: Pioneerz make you a pioneer in a fantasy world, it's a sandbox RPG focus on town protection. Help your town, improve your ability, expand your kingdom! The road is harsh to make a peaceful empire!

title: Trios
description: Trios is a relaxing, minimalist brain training game thing. Take your time, chill out with some numbers.

title: My Name is Sarah
description: The story of a character, who finds herself in the middle of forest, but knows not how she got there. The game offers so much crafting, exploration, thrill, besides being a complete survival walkthrough. Character tries to find a way out of the forest, while working to expose the mystery.

title: Toto's Toy Box
description: In this came you will go out on adventures in the world of toys. Work your way through the challenges that will come upon you in a children's room!

title: Armoured Onslaught
description: Armoured Onslaught is a fast paced Top-Down Shooter and Tower Defence hybrid. You will need to make use of both strategy and skill as you fight your way through near endless hordes of deadly foes.

title: Secret Admirer
description: Newly single, you try to enjoy your first Valentine's Day alone. You have a nice evening planned, one that will make you forget all about your past life. Just you and your wine, or so you thought.

title: Frozen Memories
description: Is it true that the picture is recorded? Not necessarily. "But I think, even if it's a fake photo, the emotions of the creators it contains are true after all." She said. So, must your memory be true again? She smiled, didn't speak, but touched the camera with her hand.

title: Great Alhcemist
description: Great Alchemist is a classic 3-in-a-row puzzle game.

title: Malvin`s Prehistoric Adventures
description: Visit the different eras, resist weather conditions, solve the puzzles, meet the spirits of the time, not all of whom will be happy to help. And collect all artifacts, because Danny can`t do it alone.

title: Nice Try!
description: One little car, one little level. What could go wrong? Apparently, everything could go wrong. Test your patience!

title: Player's Eleven
description: You're the manager and it's your team. Play Player's Eleven now! Run the club of your choice or work your way up from the bottom to the top. Extensive editing options available.

title: Samozbor ID:Heaven
description: Breach enemy stronghold in dread Siberian wastelands before insurgents can open gates to Samozbor dimension.

title: Alder's Blood: Prologue
description:
The story takes place before the events from Alder's Blood and changes the perspective from Chief of the Hunters - to a commoner, named Charles.

Charles, as everyone else in this cruel world, is struggling to stay alive. Daring his luck, out of bravery or desperation - he aims for a quick buck and attempts to hunt the spawns of darkness. If he'll survive - income from reselling the remains of the beasts will secure his livelihood for weeks to come.

What he is not aware of, is how his story will soon unfold and his life... changed forever.

In the world ruled by misery and humanity rotting in shadow of God's dead carcass - death, becomes mercy.

title: Korpus: Buried over the Black Soil
description: Korpus: Buried over the Black Soil is a first-person horror game in which you have been sent to evaluate an abandoned house, set somewhere in Eastern Europe. Uncover the houses past and the secrets buried within.

title: Outliver: Tribulation
description: Outliver: Tribulation is an atmospheric, story-driven survival horror action game where you play as Bolanle Gboyega a soldier who mysteriously finds herself in the Realm of Tribulations, a supernatural realm of African mythology where she soon discovers she has to undergo an ancient ritual in order to regain passage back to her realm… or so she thinks.

title: Psicose?
description: Running away is your only option, but beware, it can also be your end. Nathanael must go through a mysterious mansion while fleeing from something that pursues him, but ends up getting involved in an occult ritual that puts him on the threshold between reality and the surreal.

title: Wire Flying Maid
description: According to my research, most maids can fly in some way. In her case, it's two wires.

title: Kuukiyomi: Consider It!
description:
See how considerate you can be, without worrying about what others think. The smash-hit game "Consider It" is coming to Nintendo Switch with some new problems to consider and a two-player mode. Take it with you wherever you go.

So what is "Consider It"? Simply move the red object on the screen to play each problem. Most of the time you will be controlling yourself, but sometimes you might control other things too. Play through 100 problems, and get evaluated on how "considerate" you are.

Share a JoyCon with a friend and you can play the "Consider It Together" mode. We hope that this will help you build a considerate and harmonious relationship with whoever you play with...

Alone or with a friend, enjoy Consider It to your heart's content.

title: The Wonderful 101: Remastered
description:
A team of heroes from around the world must unite to protect the earth from vicious alien invaders!
This band of 100 Wonderful Ones works together using their fantastic abilities to create a variety of forms. Whether it be a giant fist or a sharp blade, they'll use their wits and power to overcome the enemy’s pitfalls and perils!
And the final member of this team of courageous heroes - is you.

title: The Perfect Concept
description: This is a short horror game, that delves into the mind of an indie game developer, trying to make the perfect horror game.

title: The Treasure of the Dragon
description: Players can access the map option in campaign mode, and choose different maps to fight on. Players can only access three maps in the beginning. You can only unlock advanced maps when you upgrade to the silver or gold level of your current class.

title: Pro 11
description: Become the best football manager! Join Pro 11 and claim the...

title: Defentures
description: Defentures - defense mid-core game. Lead your dwarves, help them to reach treasures. Choose their tiers, use magic and upgrade global skills.

title: Pixie Moon
description: The Ominous Pixie Moon is here and in its view, a tyrannical view of earth.Fire your deadly moonbeams at the planet whilst fending off the likes of missiles, rockets and lunar missions that are hoping to put a stop to this madness.This is the event of the century, be there or be vaporised horribly.

title: Space Mega Force Man
description: Space Mega Force Man is a retro space shooter game. Your ladyfriend is kidnapped by space mutants and you have to fly through the universe killing baddies, kicking ass and collecting gems along the way. Make it to the end, rescue your lady friend and get a smooch for your efforts.

title: Angry Bunny 2: Lost hole
description: Sequel to Angry Bunny game. Find bomb and explode big carrot way to home.

title: Nijikoi no Houkakou
description: Meet with the story of high school in 3 years that you can determine your life. Enjoying along with events and activities so the daily won’t be boring and comes up with a new feeling like never felt before. What are you waiting for? Let’s join us now at Hoshisora high school!

title: Random Heroes: Gold Edition
description:
The Earth is being invaded by terrifying aliens! It's up to you and a bunch of random heroes to save the day and stop the invasion! Shoot and jump your way through over 108 levels to stop the alien menace and bring peace to the planet. Will you be able to survive?
Collect cold hard cash to upgrade your arsenal and teach those invaders who's boss. Unlock new heroes to play as, each with their own unique stats.

title: Scan Your Heart
description: Scan Your Heart is a game about “Scanner and Barcode”. Using scanner to scan the barcode on your opponent to defeat him. And this game is set in Kaohsiung, Taiwan. Your can experience the beauty of Kaohsiung.

title: Isle of the Conjured
description: Isle of the Conjured is an action packed adventure. Collect Magic and equipment to protect your world from the invading demon army known as the Conjured Ones.

title: Quest Rooms
description: You wake up in an obscure room, a voice in the TV says that it is just a quest where you have to find the way out. Brute force is not enough to survive to get out of the room you will have to be patient, use your brain and have grit.

title: Battledroid
description: Battledroid is multiplayer wargaming on a global scale, where armies of Battledroids fight for domination of the Earth! Can you construct your defences to withstand enemy attacks, build up your army of Battledroids, and advance your forces over enemy lines to claim victory for your faction?

title: Mister Shizz: Don't Let the Shizz Hit the Fan!
description: Race your way to freedom on the Toiletdega T.P. track to make your escape from the Toxic Fan Monster Gourmand; he eats people like Mister Shizz for breakfast and blows bathrooms up for lunch! How long can you last in this endless runner game before Mister Shizz hits the Fan?

title: Sheptun
description: What is this dead city whispering about? Is he craving for something? Or is he afraid of something?

title: Isle of Ewe
description: Embark on an adventure and command your flock to bring your fluffy friends back home. The mysterious disappearance of Ramsey sparks your journey as you must collect, throw and bounce from sheep to sheep to bring him back home safely.

title: Harolds Harem: The Neckoning
description: In Harold's Harem, The Neckoning, you play as the newest recruit to an "Erotic Infiltration Unit" who has been tasked with extracting valuable information from the Night Supervisor of the local VHS rental store.

title: Hollow Remnant
description: Journey through the shadows of medieval fantasy as a Hollow Remnant. Forgotten to life, yet unbeknownst to death, you proceed along a veil of fragmented souls. Bump back against that which dwells in the dark, with instruments crucial to your survival.

title: Catlandia: Crisis at Fort Pawprint
description: Be a cat. Catlandia: Crisis at Fort Pawprint is a 2D turn-based RPG where you finally get to live out your dream of being a cat. Customize your cat, collect costumes, unlock powerful abilities - and fight treacherous dogs. Visit Fort Pawprint, explore the Whisker Woods, and become what you've always wanted to be.

title: US Spy: Mission in Russia
description: In this game, you have to become a spy from the USA. Your key goal is to incite a revolution in Russia. It's the right time to bribe officials and lawmakers just to make them doing those unacceptable things and accepting ridiculous laws. People have to get out on the street and riot.

title: Dungeon Marauder
description: Dungeon Marauder is a puzzle-oriented, roguelite game where you guide a knight who can only move in a single direction at a time. Cleverly use the layout of the dangerous dungeons to your advantage while avoiding traps and enemies trying to stop you in your mighty quest!

title: SCP: One More Life
description: Первая визуальная новелла по миру SCP: Foundation. Выживи в Зоне Содержания!

title: Rule the Rail!
description: Fully functional model railway building game on your screen. Create and paint the landscape, place the tracks engines and wagons. Start the trains and create control sequences to direct them to the right tracks. Place houses, industrial buildings, lamp posts, plants, and all the little details to finish your model railroad on the screen.

title: Warden of the Isles
description: Use wits, magic, and a powerful throwing arm to build and defend your town while commanding troops to fight enemies in this lighthearted VR blend of RTS and Mage Simulator. Defend against a looming and mysterious threat, uncover its dark origins, and become... The Warden of the Isles!

title: Finnish Army Simulator
description: Experience the Finnish Army around the year 2011. We want you to feel nostalgic!

title: Hot steel
description: Take on the role of a monster hunter who has occupied independent lands.

title: Mission Zigloton
description: Help Zigloton steal an old relic on his journey to infiltrate a mysterious planet, in this challenging platformer developped and hand-animated by one person.

title: Space Exodus
description: Rise and shine, pilot. In Space Exodus you take control of various gliders to defeat your enemies. Pirates from all parts of space are attacking our earth and you are our last chance to stop them. So rise to the challenge. Gameplay Fight with agile gliders and a variety of weapons.

title: Disco Simulator
description: Disco Simulator is a game where you play the role of the owner and manager of a music club. Buy equipment, sound system, lighting and decide on the appearance of your club. Make money on party people and have fun with them!

title: Vapormaze
description: Vapormaze is a roguelike shooter in a vaporwave maze. To escape, you have to carefully manage your ammo, health, items and upgrades. All while shooting and blowing up bad robots. Death is permanent.

title: Formula Retro Racing
description: Formula Retro Racing is a retro style arcade racing game that’s influenced classic arcade racing games of the early 90’s.

title: Theyest Thou
description: Play as a telekinetic gunslinger infiltrating a rebel base to find the deep space coordinates of kidnapped royalty and uncover a secret conspiracy.

title: TT Isle of Man: Ride on the Edge 2 - Ducati 900SS TT: Mike Hailwood 1978
description: As both a car and motorcycle racer, Mike is known as one of the greatest of all time in his native United Kingdom. His greatest achievements were on his motorcycle with 9 World Championships and 14 TT wins. In 1978, "Mike the Bike" returned to the Isle of Man TT, 11 years after last competing in it. He went on to win it with this Ducati 900! With your controller, relive one of the greatest moments in the history of the Isle of Man TT. This iconic bike from the 1970s gives you a unique and challenging gameplay experience.

title: Gigantosaurus: The Game
description: The most exciting episode of Gigantosaurus yet is one you get to play in. But will you be the most roarsome explorer or the fastest racer? Play together with friends and family to help Rocky, Tiny, Mazu and Bill save the day – before dino-dashing to the next zone. Dinosaurs have never had such giant fun!

title: Lights, Camera, Reaction!
description: The ultimate VR party game is finally here! LCR features a single player reaction mode, a local multiplayer mode, and an online smartphone-based multiplayer mode. The perfect game to break out during a party! Grab some family and friends or simply play with yourself!

title: Mineirinho Wildtides DC
description: In this new adventure, Miner and his friends will have to be the greatest of the seven seas to face creatures and lovecraftian places !!! A 2d platform shooter game with small rogue-like elements and physically real water !!!

title: Cutish
description: Real-time 3D first-person adventure game

title: Anonymous Letter: Prowler
description: Anonymous letter puzzle series 2，A novel form of puzzle solving combined with interesting gameplay，It has beautiful pictures and rich plots.Players need to explore puzzles step by step through rigorous scrutiny and logical ability，Puzzle solving enthusiasts are advised to have an in-depth...

title: Frontier - TRS
description: Frontier – Tactical Response Squad is a fast-paced top down shooter based in a dystopian future where mage corporations are in control. The corporations driven the environment to the edge with excessive resource extraction and humanity is forced to live in a high-tech bio domes.

title: Topfold
description: This is a classic tetris game from a different angle. You see the playing field from above and the pieces fall down from you.

title: Ily
description: Two Mushrooms, lots of puzzles!

title: Suppressor
description: Suppress them all!

title: Shutter Nyang
description: Shutter Nyang is challenging Platformer Action game. The players play as the ‘Cat’ whom got separated from his friend, a little girl. Using mystical camera, create your own unique imagination to help the ‘Cat’ get back to his friend. Nyang! Nyang! Nyang!

title: Riposte!
description: Riposte! is a local-multiplayer party fighting game for 4 to 8 people. Stab, slice, and block with a variety of weapons in 2v2 duels, 4-player free-for-alls, and other fun mini games. Fence with friends, brawl in Tavern Party mode, compete in tournament brackets, or just take a stab at… stabbing.

title: Jump Boy
description: Jump up the small steps, take a rainbow bath in the final toilet, and you will enter the next level

title: Doodle Alive
description: Puzzle game where a little doodle comes to life.

title: Forest of Math
description: Compute numeric calculations to cast magic spells. Results turn into damage towards the monsters or heal points for your hero. Explore the map, collect upgrades and banish all the bosses to save the Forest of Math.

title: Space World 2020
description: Space World™ is an educational platform that tests, teaches, and excites players/students with science, technology, engineering, and math games.

title: NonetEnsemble: Mahou shikake no Meikyuu
description: Magic Gimmick × Roguelike !! Let’s seek "Star Fragments" in challenging dungeon with Kawaii partner! Make use of Magic Stones and Gimmick from dungeon to make your way!

title: BeatBeat
description: BeatBeat is the first of its kind: A rhythm platformer. Left hand moves, right hand grooves. Every level is packed with vaporwave aesthetics and funky beats. Beat Beat the game.

title: Meowhalla
description: What can be better than cat girls? Only cat girls—Vikings! Meet the visual novel that will tell you an awesome story about cat girl intrigues in the outskirts of Valhalla.

title: The Convenience Store
description: The Convenience Store is a J-horror game about a college girl on a night shift.

title: The Sperminator: Rescuing Tzar Vlad
description: Be a Hero Super soldier Sperminator, beat evil Trumpster and Save Iconic Tzar Vlad

title: Gunman and the Witch
description: Wild West City-Builder meets Top-Down Shooter! Challenge your shooting and management skills in this 2D indie game.

title: Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure
description: Let's go on adventures with monstergirls!! This game is Roguelike RPG.

title: Foam Dart Frenzy
description: Foam Dart Frenzy is a 2D, top-down, online multiplayer shooter. Grab a dart gun and take aim at your friends!

title: Girls Deffence
description: In a world where there are only women, this is a tower defense action game where only women defend a female town! Exterminate all the onrushing enemies!

title: Frog Fractions: Game of the Decade Edition
description: The classic web game, remastered as a native executable! Follow this frog on its arcade action adventure through swarm of bugs and beyond!

title: Vzlom Zhopy
description: GOTY

title: The Race Factory
description: Made with an emphasis on local multiplayer and customization. Inspired by arcade racing games of the 80's and 90's, featuring drift physics, weapons to give you the advantage, a track editor & more, the aim is to have a fun multiplayer experience, with plenty of variety to keep you entertained!

title: Yuhha: Stolen Treasure
description: Yuhha: Stolen Treasure is a hardcore 2D platformer with horizontal teleportation on the sides of screen and vertical levels!

title: High Treason
description: High Treason is a massively multiplayer online PvP game set in a low fantasy medieval world. Create and level up your character by completing tasks such as hunting down player targets, completing quests, and looting towns, caves, and dungeons.
