description: A sequel to the Isoland series, where you continue your journey to explore the story of the universe on this island.

title: Shèngshì Zhē Tiān
description: 《盛世遮天》是一款大型多人APRG游戏，游戏中拥有养成、冒险、打斗、社交、互动等各种丰富多样的功能。玩家可以通过点击空白处的方式控制自己的角色，在3D静态地图配合2D动态模型的即时光影成像技术下与怪物战斗，和兄弟结盟，挥洒热血，激战沙场。在服务器架构上支持多服务器动态支撑技术，能容纳数万玩家在游戏内娱乐。游戏美术设计上汲取了东西方的美术元素，使用玄幻而写实的美术风格，人物造型华丽而独特，富有真实立体效果和绚丽的光影。

title: TheWandererVR
description: Simple VR Archery shooting game. Defend yourself against the oncoming enemies with arrows.

title: Rogue Frontiers
description: A challenging game of adventure and survival for you and your friends, set in a beautifully hand-crafted world with a variety of locations, challenges, and creatures. Fight, craft, build, and survive through an adventure destined to be one of your favorites!

title: Battle Bandits
description: Battle Bandits is a top down tank shooter with customisable tanks and 30 levels to complete!

title: Reconstruction
description: Reconstruction is a cyberpunk taste scrolling 3D DANMAKU shooting game in an aerially contaminated world only human beings exist. Get closer to the enemies, lock-on and destroy all of them with the missiles.

title: Xylith
description: In the vast subterranean world of Eldriss recently discovered monoliths are fueling more than just the humans fears. Sent by Nimbus you must investigate the mysterious Xylith and use any means necessary to quell an alien uprising.

title: Beatdown Brawler
description: Beatdown Brawler is a zany 3d fighting game. It also features a special rhythm mode which requires players to stay on beat as they defeat waves of enemies.

title: The Fallen
description: A third person fantasy melee combat game. Play as a knight who awakens in The Land of the...

title: Faraway
description: "I am a shooting star! A spark meant to shine and vanish in a blink. But I will travel! I will mark my trail in every firmament. I will live to see the universe." Faraway is an immersive, both challenging and chill, procedurally generated audiovisual experience about creating constellations.

title: Nyanco Channel
description: Welcome to Nyanco Channel! Whoever fights monsters should see to it that in the process that one does not become a monster. Moreover, should one gaze long enough into the abyss, the abyss will gaze back into you.

title: GOBS: Game of Battle Simulation
description: GOBS is a game where you can build your own maps and battles from each bit of wall to the paths below. Then share your battles with the world to fight to the deaths.

title: UFO Cross
description: Alien have crossed the Interstellar and attack the earth! Pick up your weapons and command your Subordinate to defeat invading aliens everywhere. Be careful，their advanced equipment can travel through time, study the enemy's technology, and travel to every time and place in the world to save people.

title: Roko-Loko into Ratozinger's Castle
description: Roko-Loko into Ratozinger’s Castle is a platform-styled action game. You will explore a huge castle with several dangers, enemies, and dungeons. If you succeed at rescuing the rockstars and unlocking the castle doors, you will finally face the evil boss, Ratozinger.

title: The Rule of Land: Pioneers
description: This is a survival game. After the coronation, human beings had to move into the underground. Fifty years later, some people thought the disaster was over and organized a survival competition on the surface. Some brave people took part in the competition . You are one of them.

title: Paper Pirates
description: Grab a crew and jump aboard a haunted pirate ship using your phones as controllers in Paper Pirates, a social deduction party game! Are you a human sailing home to shore or a ghost working against the crew? Throw your crewmates overboard, but fear not - nobody's ever out of the game!

title: Rattus
description: Play as a Rattus, a psychic rat capable of summoning meteors and altering the fabric of time. He decides to fight some birds. Can you help him survive?

title: Weed County
description: Grow, package, and sell weed while managing personal needs and furnishing your own home. Make friends with the community of Weed County by day and make drug deals at night. Buy properties and businesses to launder dirty money and pay off the debt hanging over your head.

title: Hellbound: the Awakening
description: Hellbound: the Awakening is a dark fantasy, souls-like 2D game, that will take you on a challenging journey, from a small mysterious village, to the depths of Hell itself.

title: Freedom Isn't Free
description: This game is only for those who willing to take challenge or hurt themselves.

title: Heat and Run
description: Heat and Run is a 2D multiplayer shooter, strategic and frantic! Take on players from around the world in 4vs4 battles: Select a hero with unique skills, master the creation of Blocks in intense battles and destroy the opponent Flame to win the game.

title: Bierwagen Rush
description: Bierwagen Rush is a funny casual game with a vibrant art style and unique mechanics. Inspired by the trend of craft beer festivals in Rio. Custom your beer truck and move on to sell some beers!

title: PC Futbol Stars
description: Choose your team or national colours and play massive tournaments with players coming from PC and mobile versions! Start playing now in our bottle caps soccer or football league for free! Your objective is to grow as a player and win every match in the different tournaments and events.

title: Fragsurf
description: Fragsurf is a dynamic blend of multiplayer first-person shooter PvP, strafing, surfing, and bunnyhop, allowing players to engage in high-speed maneuvers and combat.

title: Forsaken Realm
description: Forsaken Realm is a building strategy game that challenges you to build your own empire. Settle down to build your new own kingdom, develop resources and grow into an economic power.

title: Champions of Thora
description: Embark on a journey as the four chosen champions of the Goddess Thora, in an ultimate fight against her son, Ganga. The Evil Lord who seeks to destroy the world as everyone knows it to create one anew. Only you stand in his way!

title: Skinwalker Hunt
description: Skinwalker Hunt is a horror themed hunting game from the creator of Witch Hunt. Main focus of the game is on exploration, non-linearity, and atmosphere.

title: Devil's Kiss
description: Find out how it all started in this enticing Visual Novel prequel for "Lair of the Clockwork God". Join heroes Dan and Ben as they navigate a rough first school day stuffed with flirting, demons, a vast conspiracy and all manner of compromising personal information.

title: Potion Commotion
description: Live the CRAZY life of a Wizard’s assistant in this hilarious Clicker game! You’ll be in charge of making wacky and wonderful Potions, using ingredients produced in your garden. With plenty of twists and turns along the way, the fun never stops! Do you have what it takes?

title: Heroines of Swords & Spells
description: Join a team of wayward heroines in Heroines of Swords & Spells, an epic and humorous turn-based combat JRPG with over 150,000 lines of dialogue, 20 hours of gameplay, and challenging battles. Navigate tough dungeons and uncover the rich lore of the world.

title: Solo King: Single Player - Texas Hold'em Poker
description: SoloKing Poker - AI coaching and training poker software. Poker training complex tools: Poker Hand Evaluator, Showdown Calculator, Table Simulation, Equity Evaluator,Draw Evaluator, EV Evaluator, Advisor Coach. The Strongest Poker AI Opponents. No-Limit ring games, MTTs, heads-up tournaments.

title: In Her Eyes
description: A maiden(Meme) from another world is trying to summon you to help her prevent an assassination that is going to happen in 30 days. Your choice will not only affect your card deck and your battle style, but also affect the personality of the girl, which may lead to different ending.

title: Goblin Summer Camp
description: Goblin Summer Camp is a high energy multiplayer summer camp game. Double or triple down on power-ups to become the fastest, smallest, goblin ever and unlock cosmetics by completing tricky single player speed run obstacle maps.

title: Animal Shelter Simulator
description: In Animal Shelter, your main target is to make your four-legged friends happy. Pet them, hand out treats, play with toys - and they will pay you back with great trust. Get to know the animals well enough to find them the best home! Don't wait any longer, open your animal shelter now!

title: Terra Lander II: Rockslide Rescue
description: Terra Lander II - Rockslide Resuce is a sequel to Terra Lander, a homage to the classic early days of arcade retro, but this time you will need to rescue the humanoids of the landing pads from the planet through ten levels of increasing difficulty.

title: Never Date Werewolves
description: Dating a werewolf means you’re left with a litter of kids who turn into cubs when they get upset. You’ve got the silver out of the house, meat in the fridge – but contrary to your ex, you can’t turn into a wolf when the cubs decide to do a runner!

title: Amairo Chocolate
description: Autumn. With the leaves just starting to change color, a boy arrives at Yunagi Village. The first person he meets is a girl handing out flyers -- a cute, cat-eared waitress.

title: Unnamed
description: You - an Unnamed suicide with a question mark instead of a face. But it looks like dying won't be so easy.
